run_speedup_benchmark: run the speedup function to compare new and old benchmark timing lists and get percentage change
run_scale_function: run the scale function to multiply every element in a list by a given factor
run_cmp_function: run the cmp function to perform an independent t-test comparing two sample lists
review_speedup_function: review the speedup function that calculates statistically significant percentage speedup or slowdown between two benchmark runs
test_speedup_cli: test the bm_speedup module by running it directly to compare two hardcoded benchmark timing lists
